messages.subject: Top and right ticks in all facets
parts:
Hi there,

I have been struggling with this a lot, and searched everywhere in google but no success.

As a default to almost all the journals in Plant Physiology, I need to have graphs with ticks in all borders (top, bottom, left and right). I also need the ticks and axis title in all the facets.

So far, I saw the annotation_logticks does that   (sides = "tbrl"). But On my X-axis I have Date and on my Y-axis I have continuous number.

library(ggplot2)
library(gridExtra)
library(scales)
